chunks: Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام, from his forefathers عليهم السلام, who said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
Do not lodge your women in upper chambers, do not teach them writing, and do not teach them Surah Yusuf. Rather, teach them spinning and Surah al-Nur.

key_terms.الْمِغْزَلَ: the spindle; spinning as a domestic craft
key_terms.نِسَاءَكُمُ: your women; the women under a man’s household care in this report

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih say about teaching women writing, Surah Yusuf, and Surah al-Nur?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning household instruction and women’s domestic upbringing. It contrasts certain forms of accommodation and instruction with teaching spinning and Surah al-Nur, placing the report within the broader themes of family life, conduct, and transmitted Prophetic guidance.
